Sanjana Pandey | sanjana.pandey957@example.com | +91 9978185839
Pune, Maharashtra
Notice period: 60 days

Professional Summary
Result-driven business development professional with a track record of scaling B2B pipelines, implementing CRM processes and driving revenue growth through targeted lead generation and strategic account management. Experienced in deploying Salesforce and HubSpot to optimize sales workflows and improve conversion rates.

Technical Skills
B2B Sales, Salesforce, Lead Generation, CRM, HubSpot, Linux

Work Experience

Senior Business Development Manager, Zentrix Labs (Dec 2025 - Present)
- Built and prioritized a targeted outbound B2B Sales motion, generating a pipeline of enterprise opportunities worth INR 6.5M within first six months using Lead Generation and Salesforce to track outreach.
- Implemented CRM workflows and reporting in Salesforce to shorten the average sales cycle by 22% and improve forecast accuracy for the leadership team.
- Led cross-functional coordination with product and customer success to convert 4 pilot accounts into revenue-generating contracts through tailored proposals and account-based Lead Generation.

Sales Manager, Medisure (May 2025 - Nov 2025)
- Designed region-specific B2B Sales strategies and trained a team on Salesforce-driven opportunity management, resulting in a 30% uplift in qualified pipeline over four months.
- Managed strategic accounts and streamlined CRM processes to reduce contract turnaround time by 18%.
- Coordinated Lead Generation campaigns for new product launches, tracking results and follow-ups in Salesforce.

Business Development Manager, Quanta Retail (Apr 2020 - Apr 2025)
- Led Lead Generation programs targeting retail chains and omnichannel brands, sourcing and qualifying opportunities that contributed to a 40% increase in annual recurring revenue.
- Implemented HubSpot for marketing-sales alignment and integrated HubSpot with Salesforce to maintain a unified CRM and improve lead-to-opportunity conversion rates.
- Negotiated and closed multiple mid-market deals through structured outreach and account planning using Salesforce for pipeline management.

Business Development Manager, Paystack India (Apr 2018 - Mar 2020)
- Drove B2B Sales to onboard merchants and platform partners, leveraging CRM best practices and HubSpot-enabled campaigns to generate a steady stream of qualified leads.
- Managed Salesforce records and dashboards to provide weekly intelligence to senior management and optimize outreach sequences.
- Ran targeted Lead Generation initiatives for verticals, improving merchant activation rates and reducing time-to-first-transaction.

Education
MBA (Marketing), IIM Indore
